newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish April reserves rise to 101.8 bln Dkk.
newsitem.headline: Danish April reserves rise to 101.8 bln Dkk.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 101.8 billion crowns at end-April 1997 from 94.4 billion crowns at end-March, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Friday.

NOTE - In a statement the Central Bank said its net foreign loan transactions amounted to 0.1 billion crowns in April. Four analysts polled by Reuters had on average forecast Denmark's foreign reserves would rise to 100.2 billion crowns in April. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969650
